mapper.update: UPDATE SMT_ENERGY_PROJECTION_QUEUE SET QUEUE_STATUS='PENDING',REQUEST_COUNT=REQUEST_COUNT+1,LAST_REQUESTED_AT=#{requestedAt},PROCESSED_AT=NULL,LEASE_TOKEN=NULL,LAST_ERROR=NULL,RETRY_COUNT=0,NEXT_RETRY_AT=NULL WHERE METER_SOURCE=#{meterSource} AND METER_ID=#{meterId} AND STAT_DATE=#{statDate}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM (SELECT ID,METER_SOURCE,METER_ID,STAT_DATE,QUEUE_STATUS,REQUEST_COUNT,LAST_REQUESTED_AT,PROCESSED_AT,LEASE_TOKEN,LAST_ERROR,RETRY_COUNT,NEXT_RETRY_AT FROM SMT_ENERGY_PROJECTION_QUEUE WHERE (QUEUE_STATUS='PENDING' AND (NEXT_RETRY_AT IS NULL OR NEXT_RETRY_AT <= #{now})) OR (QUEUE_STATUS='PROCESSING' AND PROCESSED_AT <= #{now}) ORDER BY LAST_REQUESTED_AT, ID) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE SMT_ENERGY_PROJECTION_QUEUE SET QUEUE_STATUS='PROCESSING', PROCESSED_AT=#{leaseExpiresAt}, LEASE_TOKEN=#{leaseToken}, LAST_ERROR=NULL WHERE ID=#{id} AND REQUEST_COUNT=#{expectedRequestCount} AND (QUEUE_STATUS='PENDING' OR (QUEUE_STATUS='PROCESSING' AND PROCESSED_AT <= #{claimedAt}))

UPDATE SMT_ENERGY_PROJECTION_QUEUE SET QUEUE_STATUS=#{status}, PROCESSED_AT=#{processedAt}, LEASE_TOKEN=NULL, LAST_ERROR=#{lastError} WHERE ID=#{id} AND QUEUE_STATUS='PROCESSING' AND REQUEST_COUNT=#{expectedRequestCount} AND LEASE_TOKEN=#{leaseToken}
mapper.select: SELECT ID FROM SMT_ENERGY_PROJECTION_QUEUE WHERE ID=#{id} AND QUEUE_STATUS='PROCESSING' AND REQUEST_COUNT=#{expectedRequestCount} AND LEASE_TOKEN=#{leaseToken} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE SMT_ENERGY_PROJECTION_QUEUE SET RETRY_COUNT=RETRY_COUNT+1, QUEUE_STATUS=CASE WHEN RETRY_COUNT+1 < #{maxRetryCount} THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'FAILED' END, NEXT_RETRY_AT=CASE WHEN RETRY_COUNT+1 < #{maxRetryCount} THEN #{nextRetryAt} ELSE NULL END, PROCESSED_AT=#{failedAt}, LEASE_TOKEN=NULL, LAST_ERROR=#{lastError} WHERE ID=#{id} AND QUEUE_STATUS='PROCESSING' AND REQUEST_COUNT=#{expectedRequestCount} AND LEASE_TOKEN=#{leaseToken}
